title: Association statement cache cause wrong query after table name changed
body:
When accessing an association, a partial query is cached for the relation. After the association's table name changed, the previous cached query is used instead of generating new SQL from the new table.

The project which i'm working on require changing the table name before each request to apply the appropriate database view for the models.

### Steps to reproduce
<!-- (Guidelines for creating a bug report are [available
here](https://edgeguides.rubyonrails.org/contributing_to_ruby_on_rails.html#creating-a-bug-report)) -->
```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "bundler/inline"

gemfile(true) do
  source "https://rubygems.org"

  git_source(:github) { |repo| "https://github.com/#{repo}.git" }

  gem "rails", "5.1.7"
  gem "sqlite3"
end

require "active_record"
require "minitest/autorun"
require "logger"

# This connection will do for database-independent bug reports.
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: "sqlite3", database: ":memory:", prepared_statements: false)
ActiveRecord::Base.logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)

ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  create_table :posts, force: true do |t|
  end

  create_table :comments, force: true do |t|
    t.integer :post_id
    t.boolean :hidden, default: false
  end
end

ActiveRecord::Base.connection.execute <<-SQL
  CREATE VIEW visible_comments
    AS SELECT * FROM comments WHERE comments.hidden = 'f';
SQL

class Post < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :comments
end

class Comment < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :post
end

class BugTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_query_from_wrong_table
    post = Post.create!
    post.comments << Comment.create!
    post.comments << Comment.create!(hidden: true)

    assert_equal 2, post.comments.length

    Comment.table_name = "visible_comments"
    assert_equal 1, Comment.count
    assert_equal 1, Post.first.comments.length
  end
end
```

### Expected behavior
<!-- Tell us what should happen -->
After Comment's table name changed to `visible_comments`.
`Post.first.comments` generate the query:
```sql
SELECT "visible_comments".* FROM "visible_comments" WHERE "visible_comments"."post_id" = 1  [["post_id", 1]]
```


### Actual behavior
<!-- Tell us what happens instead -->
After Comment's table name changed to `visible_comments`.
`Post.first.comments` generate the query:
```sql
SELECT "comments".* FROM "comments" WHERE "comments"."post_id" = 1  [["post_id", 1]]
````

### System configuration
**Rails version**: 5.1.7

**Ruby version**: 2.4.4
